pr_title: Fix API request potentially firing failed events after completion
pr_body:
Specifically, `Cancel()` calls were not thread safe. Due to a series of events, `ListPollingComponent` could call `Cancel` from a non-update thread, leading to a race condition where both a `Success` and `Fail` event can be fired.

This is intended to be the simplest fix possible, locking and guarding specifically on the callbacks. Further work could be done in the future to improve the flow surrounding `pendingFailure`, potentially reducing redundant work and cleaning up the code, but that's not happening here.

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/13632 in theory.
pr_comments: I don't want this in today's release so please don't merge until tomorrow or later. While it looks fine, I'd rather it gets some more testing to ensure there's nothing weird regressing in such a critical code path.

issue_context.title: Exception when entering the multiplayer screen
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 

Got this exception once when entering the multiplayer screen quickly upon startup. May be related to using a local-osu!web instance, for repro purposes.

```
Unhandled exception. System.InvalidOperationException: An attempt was made to transition a task to a final state when it had already completed.
   at System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCompletionSource`1.SetResult(TResult result)
   at osu.Game.Screens.OnlinePlay.Components.ListingPollingComponent.<>c__DisplayClass10_0.<Poll>b__1(Exception _) in /home/smgi/Repos/osu/osu.Game/Screens/OnlinePlay/Components/ListingPollingComponent.cs:line 62
   at osu.Game.Online.API.APIRequest.TriggerFailure(Exception e) in /home/smgi/Repos/osu/osu.Game/Online/API/APIRequest.cs:line 144
   at osu.Game.Online.API.APIRequest.<>c__DisplayClass25_0.<Fail>b__0() in /home/smgi/Repos/osu/osu.Game/Online/API/APIRequest.cs:line 174
   at osu.Framework.Threading.ScheduledDelegate.RunTaskInternal()
```

**Logs:**

Lost :/

review_comments: As per the original description, I intentionally *didn't* touch `pendingFailure`. The goal is to fix the public events. Even in your scenario, the success/fail trigger will still happen once, with no other critical failures as far as I can tell.
